headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 25, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 11.59%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 8.05%. This results in an average alpha of 3.54%, indicating that the portfolios are not only growing but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 35.58%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', returned only 2.37%, highlighting the variability within the portfolio set. Outperforming SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market stress, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
